- Branch: main
- Written in worktree: /workspace/catalyst
- Done when: Tier 2 v0.5 shipped with all 3 skills passing pass@3 >= 0.90 + handoff v0.3 / Tier 1 regression at pass^3 = 1.00.
- Next acceptance check: Tier 2 v0.5 shipped with all 3 skills passing pass@3 >= 0.90 + handoff v0.3 / Tier 1 regression at pass^3 = 1.00.
- Diff: clean working tree

  - Tier 1 is SHIPPED as v0.4 (live as v0.1.13). Skills: handoff (v0.3), verify-gate (v0.4), hooks (v0.4). All 4 commands work.
  - Next build target: Tier 2 per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-24-tier-2-orchestration-extensions-design.md
  - Build Catalyst with Catalyst: dogfood catalyst:handoff PIPELINE mode + catalyst:verify-gate + catalyst:hooks install --all

  - Tier 2 failure-pattern-detector overlaps with Tier 3 session-degradation-watch on repeated-tool-call + stale-read signals.
